decision_scope: Determine whether an authoritative, ordered vocabulary and encoder for all 21 packaged x columns can be authenticated. General provenance or eCAR field descriptions do not qualify as a ProvX feature vocabulary.
allowed_authority: Authenticated Zenodo record and its shipped archive
Official/cited source repositories explicitly named by the paper

findings: One file, ProvX-USENIX-artifact.zip, is published.
Metadata describes code, detector, mask learning, solidification, and evaluation utilities but no feature vocabulary or preprocessing package.

searched: all packaged project files and strings
findings: README defines x as a node feature matrix and lists graph fields x, edge_index, _VULN, _LINE, and _SAMPLE.
data.py only loads serialized PyG objects and derives labels/identifiers; it contains no raw-event parser or encoder.
detector.py consumes x, edge_index, and optional batch; no feature names or entity/event enums are referenced.
training.py uses _VULN only for graph labels and contains no feature construction.
provx.py and evaluation.py operate on graph tensors and masks; they contain no feature construction, Louvain implementation, or live collector boundary.
scripts only infer x.size(1), load partitions/checkpoints, train, explain, or evaluate.
checkpoint metadata records architecture/training settings but no feature names, order, normalization, or source revision.
sample_labels_all.pkl contains removed line identifiers keyed by sample ID; it is evaluation metadata, not a feature map.
sources.feature_vocabulary_evidence: width=21 and dtype=float32 are authenticated; semantics/order/normalization are absent

searched: serialized Data field names and tensor statistics
findings: All partitions contain PyG Data with x shaped [N,21] float32 and no feature-name sidecar.
_VULN, _LINE, and _SAMPLE are integer metadata/labels and do not identify x columns.
Observed value distributions cannot establish semantics and were not used to infer any mapping.

searched: model.bin state keys and tensor shapes
findings: feature_transform.0.weight has shape [64,21], confirming only the input width.
State keys encode layer names and dimensions, not semantic feature names or preprocessing constants.
The paper describes process, file, and socket examples, causal dependencies, a node feature matrix X_k, and a Louvain-based evaluation subgraph procedure.
The paper states that semantic attributes alone are less discriminative than structure but does not publish an ordered 21-column vocabulary.
The paper states that deployment can receive alert-associated subgraphs from PIDS/EDR/SIEM/network/analyst workflows and that enforcement mapping is deployment-specific.
Implementation details provide model and Phase-II hyperparameters but no raw-to-feature encoder, column names, normalization constants, or serialized schema.
R0-R2 explicitly record that 21-column semantics are undefined by the artifact.
R2 pins x + edge_index (+ optional batch) as runtime input and _VULN/_LINE/_SAMPLE/sample_labels_all.pkl as evaluation metadata.
Existing reports prohibit inventing a live mapping from statistics.
README documents endpoint JSON records, eCAR translation, and data folders but no ProvX feature encoder.
eCAR documents timestamp, IDs, hostname, object, action, actor, PID/TID/principal, and string properties; these are source-event semantics, not the 21 x-column order.
Errata documents data-quality issues, reinforcing that source normalization would need an explicit new contract.
sources.feature_vocabulary_evidence: general source-event schema only; no ProvX mapping

findings: README-E3 documents TA1 provenance data, CDM schema/tools, and engagement files; it does not define ProvX x columns.
README describes process/file/system-component provenance at a broad program level, not a detector feature vocabulary or normalization implementation.
The repository tree contains no ProvX source or 21-feature sidecar.
sources.feature_vocabulary_evidence: general provenance/CDM context only; no ProvX mapping

local_commands: rg --files and targeted rg over artifact, reports, scripts, metadata, and paper text
read-only inspection of all 17 artifact project/source files and checkpoint metadata
read-only pickle key/type inspection and tensor schema inspection already recorded by R2
sha256sum for local evidence and downloaded official documentation
network_commands: GitHub API repository metadata/tree/HEAD for FiveDirections/OpTC-data
GitHub API repository metadata/tree/HEAD for darpa-i2o/Transparent-Computing

conclusion: The search is complete and no authoritative source defines the ordered semantics and deterministic encoding of all 21 packaged x columns. Width and dtype alone cannot authenticate compatibility with newly encoded Mininet provenance.
